paragraphs.text: Warlord Mandek Ironfist was a warlord of the Darkling Plains of Golthonor on Corondor .

With the aid of Archmage Xarl , the Serra Angel Trine was summoned by the wizard Skule , and Mandek was forced to sacrifice his nephew to Trine. This was the beginning of the Enslavement of Trine , 326 dark years when countless lives were lost on Corondor. After the summoning, Mandek ordered her to kill the people of Gan and their Golthan army. After Xarl became the Angel-Keeper, Mandek founded the Iron Kingdom .
